fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satire on Miami and Florida civic life, including controversy over Swami Yogananda and a letter from his attorney; commentary on elections and office-holders; discussion of tourism and the impact of restrictions on racing and other amusements; local transportation and street-safety complaints (taxicab rates, traffic lights, parking); Miami Beach consumer and hotel-security complaints; and recurring columns and notices, including entertainment/nightlife items and sports coverage (boxing).
